## D — Accuracy and verification, Traffic signs, route markers and sign colors

Section D records the accuracy posture for traffic signs, route markers and sign colors. Every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 traces to exactly one cited physical handbook page, and that page states the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned October edition of the handbook. No fact needed a lower confidence flag, so no verification debt was opened and no external review was requested. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or sample question is reproduced. Sign plaque values such as speeds, clearances and parking hours are recorded exactly as printed in the pinned edition; no figure was taken from outside the handbook. No location-variable fact needed isolation as dynamic knowledge.
